fichas.title: Entrance hall
fichas.summary: The entrance hall should provide adequate space for greeting, moving around, taking off and putting on coats, and orienting visitors. Where the entrance opens directly outdoors, an inner door can provide a wind-lobby function. Arrange belongings practically and tidily, and provide direct access to important shared areas such as the kitchen, WC, and stairs.
furniture_equipment: Storage for coats, jackets, umbrellas, hats, briefcases, and shoes

Entrance hall
The entrance hall should be enclosed where the entrance leads
directly to the open air with an inner door (wind lobby function).
It should also offer sufficient room for a lot of moving around ~
0. This is where reception, greeting, taking off and putting
on coats, and taking leave all take place, but also offers the
first orientation for the visitor ~ 0 - 0. Countless objects
therefore have to be arranged practically yet tidily in this limited
space ~ 0, 0. The most important communal areas like the
kitchen, WC and staircase should be directly accessible from
the entrance hall.
